A document is required when its number appears nowhere in phaseb_b1 to phaseb_b4.

reconciliation.note: All 34 of the auditor's required pairs appear inside required_split or required_open_leg. Three did not fall out of the round-two sweep as first run, because that run matched a leg only to a counterparty carrying identical column N text: 5117130089 ("AS 2025 DATAIKU CHARGE" against "RECHARGE 2025 DATAIKU TO AS"), 5117863517 ("POWERBI PRO JAKE EDWARDS" against "POWERBI PRO MDEPOPS") and 5119661592 ("SIGMA PLATFORMA/ACT/BUILD/VIEW SUBS-4/27" against its REPOST leg). All three are included here and carry basis "auditor qa_r2_01 addition". The auditor's twenty optional same-destination documents all appear in exempt_same_destination, two of them (5117659227 and 5119481423) only after nil-value leg pairs were carried in, which the round-two sweep skipped.

pairing_correction.detail: CO document 5120406644 carries three legs: S17467 in the pooled centre at +315.00 for LYIEW1, and S18529 and S18530 in APPLHHR at -315.00 each for DMCINTY and LYIEW1. The round-two sweep matched S17467 to S18529 and read the pair as variant text. Matching identical column N first pairs S17467 with S18530, so the document is a same-text split pair and belongs in the required list.

variant_text_candidates_pending_ruling.detail: Seven monthly documents pairing "CONTENTSTACK LICENSE" in APPLBRNDCOMS against "IT SERVICES <month>" in the pooled centre, 67,795.00, and CO document 5120390441 pairing the Atlassian Xray renewal across the pooled centre and TDDEINTSIG, 3,098.90. 5120390441 is already inside the ruled set on a second pair, so the union adds seven documents, not eight.

movement_from_round_two.note: CO document 5118029102 carries both a split pair and an open-leg pair, so it appears in both required lists; 81 plus 10 less that one document is 90.
